title: The Party At Grammie’s Dream
excerpt: A party happens at my grandmother's house.
content: There's not much to say about this one, being a graveyard dream and all. There was a party happening at my grandmother's house, and that's all I can remember.

title: The Upper Thomas Cabinet Dream
excerpt: Something Thomas Wooden Railway Related.
content: This dream had something to with Thomas Wooden Railway, and a non-floor cabinet. That's all I've got for this one, folks.

title: The School In My Bed Dream
excerpt: School happens, but in my bed.
content: In this one, school was happening in my bed. I don't know how or why, and the only aspect that I actually remember other than that is that this was high school era.

title: The Christmas Party Dream
excerpt: Something to do with a Christmas party.
content: Yeah, this dream had something to do with a Christmas party and that's it. It's honestly almost not enough to be a graveyard dream, but I like be thorough.

title: The Mat And My Brother Contest Dream
excerpt: A contest involving my friend Mat and my brother.
content: I think in this one, my brother and my friend Mat were hosting separate contests and I had to participate in both of them, but I can't say for sure.

title: The High School Beach Washing Dream
excerpt: I really couldn't tell you with this one.
content: Other than what you can get from the title (it was high school era, and it took place at the beach), I know this dream had an acquaintance of mine from middle/high school in it.

title: The Minecraft Mario Maker Dream
excerpt: Minecraft and Mario Maker meet in some way.
content: As is the usual for graveyard dreams, I don't remember anything about it. What's in the title is what you get, which sounds kind of interesting. I wish I remembered this one.

title: The Brother Old School Cake Dream
excerpt: Something to do with my brother, school, and cake.
content: There's a good chance I had this dream when I was in elementary school, and if not, it was early middle school. That's to say I'm lucky to have remembered enough to give it a title.

title: The Bleach And Mario Dream
excerpt: Characters from Bleach and Mario do stuff, probably.
content: This specifically involved the characters Mario and Luigi from the Mario series, and Ruika, Renji, and Matsumoto from the Bleach series, and I believe we were all in a friend group type of relationship.

title: The Anime Bookmarks At Grammie’s Dream
excerpt: I make bookmarks featuring anime-style characters.
content: I was making anime bookmarks at my grandmother's house on my dad's side. I have done this once in real life, drawing an anime character on a cue card and taping it up to serve as a bookmark, and I think I made them in that style in the dream.

title: The Christmas With The Cranks Dream
excerpt: A dream involving the hit film Christmas With The Cranks.
content: I don't remember even the slightest thing about this one. The only thing I do remember at all is that I probably had this dream because I got a VHS copy of the movie at the time.

title: The Invincible Boat Dream
excerpt: A boat and the TV show Invincible happen, I suppose.
content: Despite never actually having seen the show (just clips), I managed to have a dream about Invincible. On one hand, that's probably why I forgot the dream. On the other hand, I find it interesting when I have dreams about things I don't know about, so I wish I remembered this one.

title: The Victor And Sam Dream
excerpt: My friend Victor and my acquaintance female Sam interact probably.
content: Although I've never really interacted too much with female Sam back in the day, she's appeared in my dreams a relatively often. I think there's two reasons for this though. One is that pretty much all the people who went from the start of elementary to high school are a bit special. That's 9 to 12 years being together, even if you're not close. The second reason is much more simple, though. She's one of the people I go "oh, it's weird that I had a dream about her," and thinking that thought every time naturally leads to the brain making enforcing some connections. Oh, and Victor was in this one too, haha.

title: The Watching Anime With Pamela Dream
excerpt: My friend Pamela and I watch anime together.
content: The title is as it says with this one. I don't remember what anime we were watching or anything like that, just that we were watching anime.

title: The Maze-Like School Dream
excerpt: One of my schools being very maze-like.
content: I don't even remember which era of school this was, so yeah, really not a lot to say for this one.

title: The Daniel E3 Room Dream
excerpt: Me and Daniel go to E3.
content: I really wish I could remember this one since it sounds pretty cool to go to E3, but hey, what can you do?

title: The Nami Dream
excerpt: Nami from One Piece does stuff most likely.
content: Nami from One Piece is in this dream, but I can't say I remember anything about her involvement. She's a cool character, but probably not in my top 10, so I'm not too upset about forgetting this one.

title: The Dad Blue Shorts Dream
excerpt: My dad wears a pair of my shorts.
content: I have a pair of blue shorts, and my dad wears them in this dream... I'm pretty sure that's happened in real life.

title: The Straight Sherlock Holmes DVD Dream
excerpt: One of my DVDs defies gravity.
content: I have a DVD set of a black and white Sherlock Holmes series, and it's at the end of my shelf, so it falls over instead of standing up straight. In this dream, it was somehow standing up straight... Pretty wild stuff.

title: The Kidnapped Dream
excerpt: I get kidnapped.
content: I think I was the one who got kidnapped in this dream, but I don't remember it being scary or anything like that.

title: The Ms. Middle School English Presentation Dream
excerpt: My middle school English teacher does a presentation I think.
content: Fairly simple with this one. Either my middle school English teacher did a presentation, or the students were. At the very least, I don't think I was.

title: The Bedroom Videos Dream
excerpt: Creatures watch while I make videos in my room.
content: In this one, I was recording some sort of video in my room, while creatures of some sorts watched me. I don't remember what the creatures were, but the fact they were creatures and not people makes me really wish I could remember.
